name: section_heading
label: Section Heading
help_text: Heading displayed at the top of the services section

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: section_description
label: Section Description
help_text: Description text shown below the section heading
default: Explore everything available to you as a member. Services marked Gold are unlocked when you reach Gold tier.

name: category_filter_placeholder
label: Category Placeholder Text
help_text: Default option shown in Category dropdown

name: services_table
label: Services HubDB Table
help_text: Select the HubDB table that contains service data. This is display-only — the module is wired to table ID 1680589250 in code.

name: locked_button_text
label: Locked Card Button Text
help_text: Text shown on the CTA button of locked service cards

name: cta_button_text
label: Default CTA Button Text
help_text: Button text shown on unlocked service cards when the member has NOT yet enquired about the service.

name: cta_button_text_after
label: CTA Button Text (After First Enquiry)
help_text: Shown once the member has submitted the service form at least once. The 'Enquired · N' pill appears above the button in that same state.

name: services_base_path
label: Services Base URL
help_text: Base URL for service detail pages — pick the parent CMS page (e.g. /services). Links are built as this URL + the HubDB hs_path slug. Leave empty to use the default fallback ("/services/").

name: empty_state_text
label: Empty State Text
help_text: Message shown when no services are found in HubDB.
default: No services available at this time.

name: load_more_text
label: Load More Button Text
help_text: Text on the Load More button that appears below the service cards.

children.name: background_color
children.label: Background Color
children.help_text: Leave empty to use theme default (#f7f7f7)

children.name: padding_top
children.label: Padding Top (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: padding_bottom
children.label: Padding Bottom (px)
children.help_text: Leave empty to use default spacing

children.name: hide_on_mobile
children.label: Hide on Mobile
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on mobile devices

children.name: text_color
children.label: Text Color
children.help_text: Override the default text color for this module instance. Leave empty for theme default.

children.name: content_width
children.label: Content Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of this module's content.

children.name: hide_on_desktop
children.label: Hide on Desktop
children.help_text: Toggle to hide this module on desktop viewports.
